message:
The users API test now passes (`npm test`: 1 pass, 0 fail).

The migration `001_create_users.js` creates the column as `fullname`, but `src/api/users.js` read and wrote `full_name`. That mismatch caused the "unknown column users.full_name" error. I changed the API to use `fullname` in both `createUser` and `getUser`. I didn't touch `migrations/`, since it belongs to the DBA team and is already applied in production.
